remainingLimitations: Historical rejected drafts and exact failed generation payloads unavailable; structural replay is synthetic.
Real Qwen/Gemma generation quality, real tokenizer counts and throughput not tested.

Estimate-only generation or continuation measurements cannot authorize checkpoint activation/dispatch. Cloud tokenizer availability remains a deployment limitation; deterministic fallback may also be infeasible.

Generated merge/correction contents are data-dependent: actual complete requests are measured again before dispatch. An oversized merge is a bounded fallback/non-success, not a proven guaranteed full checkpoint for arbitrary maximum semantic output.

Partial coverage of completed historical messages remains whole-message only; safe operation prefixes apply to the current owning in-progress message and only complete protocol rounds can leave its tail.
Exact degraded checkpoint can run out of room, particularly with large task briefs, prior exact state or one indivisible operation. It never advances coverage over omitted text.
No claim of exhaustive randomized proof of all application interleavings, semantic entailment or every property under every provider.
